title: SOP Training and Authorization Verification Record
description: A training evidence record linking a learner and role to the controlled SOP version, training method, knowledge check, observed practice, restrictions, remediation, and authorization decision.
instructions: Identify the exact controlled SOP version covered by the training event.
Record knowledge and observed-practice results independently when both are required.
Document restrictions, remediation, and retraining triggers without implying authorization.
Require the designated authorizing role to make and record the final work-authorization decision.
limitations: Course or template completion alone does not authorize controlled work.
The organization must define qualified assessors, passing rules, retraining triggers, record retention, and authorization roles.
